settings.description: Compact the context at natural breaks in the work instead of once when it is nearly full.

settings.description: Lets the agent read and act on your GitHub repositories, issues and pull requests.

settings.title: Import cookies
settings.description: Import a cookie export or a local browser profile into the agent's browser.

settings.title: Shared screen
settings.description: The screen Computer Use sees, remembered between restarts.

settings.title: Phone app on this network
settings.description: Lets the 1loop phone app find and reach this computer, once paired.

settings.description: Pair a phone with a QR code, or forget one.

settings.description: What shows over your other apps while the agent works: a small badge, a Live Update or nothing.

settings.description: A separate Android profile where the agent installs and uses its apps.
